title: Core admin read-only console face with apps/admin web and realm administrator acceptance
objective: Deliver the ADR-0018 first admin-console slice: contract-first Core 0.1.0-alpha.9 read-only admin operations (admin:read), Core producer with scope+ADMIN-role+ACTIVE authorization, Ops realm-designated administrator with real acceptance and negatives, and the apps/admin PKCE web console for users/credits/entitlements/audit/outbox browsing.
in_scope: Contracts: core.yaml 0.1.0-alpha.9 locks six read-only admin operations (listAdminUsers, getAdminUser, listAdminCreditLedger, listAdminEntitlementRecords, listAdminAuditRecords, listAdminOutboxRecords) under userOAuth scope admin:read with cursor pagination and field-closed schemas (no email/secret exposure); validate_contracts.py alpha.9 machine gates; SDK surface unchanged (17 operations, admin ops excluded until producer evidence)

Core producer: src/admin module with AdminStore port plus Prisma implementation, authorization = admin:read scope plus ADMIN business role plus ACTIVE status, PAT catalog excludes admin:read (UNKNOWN_SCOPE), service tokens rejected; contract/unit/e2e/integration tests and full gates; contracts/core-api.lock.json updated to alpha.9

Ops: realm admin:read client scope plus designated administrator user plus admin web PKCE client; validate-dev-environment.ps1 static gates; real-stack acceptance script covering administrator PKCE login and all six query surfaces plus labeled negatives (non-admin scope/role, PAT, service token)

apps/admin Next.js workspace package in mc-plan-core: PKCE login, users list/search, user detail, credit ledger, entitlement records, audit log, outbox delivery status pages calling the REST API directly; browser e2e smoke

Community moderation queue/dual-review/appeals and any Community/Skin business change; SDK exposure of admin operations; production deployment

apps/admin browser e2e green against the real local stack (login + users + detail + ledger pages)
